units.zh: 列傳一百六十四
units.en: Biography 164
units.literal: Biographies, Number 164

units.zh: 鮑桂星顧吳孝銘陳鴻鄂木順額徐法績
units.en: Bao Guixing, Gu Chun, Wu Xiaoming, Chen Hong, E Mushune, and Xu Faji
units.literal: Bao Guixing, Gu Chun, Wu Xiaoming, Chen Hong, E Mushune, and Xu Faji

units.zh: 鮑桂星，字雙五，安徽歙縣人。
units.en: Bao Guixing, whose courtesy name was Shuangwu, came from She County in Anhui.
units.literal: Bao Guixing, style name Shuangwu, was a man of She County, Anhui.

units.zh: 嘉慶四年進士，選庶吉士，授編修，遷中允。
units.en: He earned his jinshi degree in the fourth year of the Jiaqing reign, entered the Hanlin Academy as a bachelor, became a compiler, and rose to vice-director of the Secretariat.
units.literal: In the fourth year of Jiaqing he passed the jinshi examination, was selected as a bachelor of the Hanlin Academy, was appointed compiler, and was promoted to vice-director of the Secretariat.

units.zh: 九年，典試河南，留學政。
units.en: In the ninth year he presided over the Henan provincial examination and stayed on as educational commissioner.
units.literal: In the ninth year he served as chief examiner for Henan and remained behind as educational commissioner.

units.zh: 十三年，典試江西。
units.en: In the thirteenth year he presided over the Jiangxi provincial examination.
units.literal: In the thirteenth year he served as chief examiner for Jiangxi.

units.zh: 十五年，督湖北學政。
units.en: In the fifteenth year he was appointed educational commissioner of Hubei.
units.literal: In the fifteenth year he supervised education in Hubei.

units.zh: 累遷至內閣學士。
units.en: He rose through successive promotions to Grand Secretariat academician.
units.literal: He was promoted in succession to Grand Secretariat academician.

units.zh: 十八年，任滿，既受代，聞林清之變，疏陳十事，急馳至京，仁宗嘉之，曰：「汝所奏已次第施行矣。」
units.en: In the eighteenth year, as soon as his term ended and he had handed over his post, he learned of Lin Qing's uprising. He submitted a memorial outlining ten measures and rushed to the capital. Emperor Renzong praised him, saying, "The items you raised are already being implemented, one after another."
units.literal: In the eighteenth year, when his term ended and he had already handed over office, he heard of the Lin Qing incident, memorialized ten matters in a memorial, and hurried to the capital; the Renzong Emperor praised him, saying, "What you memorialized has already been carried out in order."

units.zh: 擢工部侍郎，充武英殿總裁。
units.en: He was promoted to vice minister of Works and appointed chief director of the Wuying Hall.
units.literal: He was promoted to vice minister of the Ministry of Works and made chief director of the Wuying Hall.

units.zh: 桂星性質直，勇於任事。
units.en: Guixing was blunt and upright by nature, and bold in shouldering responsibility.
units.literal: Guixing's nature was upright and blunt, and he was bold in taking on affairs.

units.zh: 十九年，疏陳刊書及校勘事宜。
units.en: In the nineteenth year he submitted a memorial on book publishing and textual collation.
units.literal: In the nineteenth year he memorialized on the publication of books and matters of collation and proofreading.

units.zh: 又劾提調劉榮​​黼等不職，命王大臣按之。
units.en: He also impeached supervising officials including Liu Rongdian for neglect of duty, and the throne ordered a senior prince-minister to conduct an inquiry.
units.literal: He also impeached the supervising officials Liu Rongdian and others for dereliction of duty, and the emperor ordered a princely minister to investigate.

units.zh: 榮黼面訐桂星曾言滿總裁熙昌所校，不過偏旁點畫，修改徒延時日；
units.en: Rongdian confronted Guixing in person, alleging that Guixing had once said the Manchu chief director Xi Chang's collation work amounted to nothing more than tweaking radicals and stroke dots, needlessly dragging out the schedule;
units.literal: Rongdian confronted Guixing face to face, charging that Guixing had once said that what the Manchu chief director Xi Chang had collated amounted only to radicals and dots and strokes, and that the revisions merely prolonged the days;

units.zh: 且言近日有旨，旗人不足恃，故督撫多用漢人。
units.en: and further claimed that a recent edict had declared Bannermen unreliable, so that governors-general and governors were increasingly appointing Han Chinese.
units.literal: and he also said that recently there had been an edict that Bannermen could not be relied upon, so governors-general and governors increasingly employed Han Chinese.

units.zh: 上聞之，怒，命傳詢。
units.en: The emperor heard of it, grew furious, and ordered the matter referred for investigation.
units.literal: When the emperor heard this he grew angry and ordered the matter transmitted for inquiry.

units.zh: 桂星對聞自侍郎周兆基，且言在部與滿員共事，多有徇私背公，而兆基不承；
units.en: Guixing answered that he had heard it from Vice Minister Zhou Zhaoji, adding that in the ministry he had often seen Manchu colleagues indulge private favor at public expense, which Zhaoji denied;
units.literal: Guixing replied that he had heard it from vice minister Zhou Zhaoji, and also said that in the ministry, when working with Manchu colleagues, there was much favoritism contrary to the public good, yet Zhaoji would not admit it;

units.zh: 又指同官熙昌及慶溥囑託部事，兩人亦不承。
units.en: he also accused colleagues Xi Chang and Qing Pu of soliciting favors in ministry business, and both denied it.
units.literal: he also named colleagues Xi Chang and Qing Pu as having solicited favors in ministry affairs, and neither of the two would admit it.

units.zh: 以任性妄言，下部嚴議，詔斥桂星指訐慶溥、熙昌囑託無據，其咎小；
units.en: For reckless and willful speech the case was sent to the ministry for severe deliberation. An edict rebuked Guixing: his charge that Qing Pu and Xi Chang had solicited favors lacked proof and was a lesser offense;
units.literal: Because of willful reckless speech, the case was sent down to the ministry for severe deliberation; an edict rebuked Guixing: accusing Qing Pu and Xi Chang of solicitation was without evidence—the fault was small;

units.zh: 妄言朝廷輕滿洲重漢人，亂政之大者：革職，不准回籍，令在京閉門思過，責五城御史嚴察；
units.en: but claiming the court slighted Manchus while favoring Han Chinese was a grave offense against good government. He was stripped of office, forbidden to return home, ordered to remain in Beijing under house arrest to reflect on his conduct, with the Five-City censors instructed to keep strict watch;
units.literal: recklessly saying that the court slighted Manchus and favored Han Chinese was a great matter of disordering government: he was dismissed from office, not permitted to return to his native place, ordered to remain in the capital behind closed doors to reflect on his faults, and the Five-City censors were charged to watch him strictly;

units.zh: 如私著詩文有怨望誹謗之詞，從重治罪。
units.en: and if any private poetry or prose he composed contained resentment or slander, he was to be punished severely.
units.literal: if in private writings of poetry or prose there were words of resentment, discontent, or slander, he was to be punished severely.

units.zh: 越五年，上意解，复官編修。
units.en: Five years later, when the emperor's anger had cooled, Guixing was restored to his former post as compiler.
units.literal: Five years later the emperor's anger eased, and his office as compiler was restored.

units.zh: 宣宗即位，召對，諭曰：「汝昔所劾，今已罷斥。」
units.en: When Emperor Daoguang ascended the throne, Guixing was summoned for an audience. The emperor told him, "The men you impeached back then have now been removed from office."
units.literal: When the Daoguang Emperor took the throne, Guixing was summoned for audience; the emperor instructed him, saying, "Those you impeached in the past have now been dismissed."

units.zh: 擢侍講，又擢通政司副使，意頗鄉用。
units.en: He was promoted to expositor-in-waiting and then to vice commissioner of the Office of Transmission, and the court appeared ready to make greater use of him.
units.literal: He was promoted to expositor-in-waiting, then again to vice commissioner of the Office of Transmission, and the court seemed inclined to employ him.

units.zh: 道光四年，擢詹事。
units.en: In the fourth year of Daoguang he was promoted to Supervisor of the Household of the Heir Apparent.
units.literal: In the fourth year of Daoguang he was promoted to Supervisor of the Household of the Heir Apparent.

units.zh: 未幾，卒。
units.en: Not long afterward he died.
units.literal: Before long he died.

units.zh: 桂星少從同縣吳定學，後師姚鼐，詩古文並有法，著有進奉文及詩集，又嘗用司空圖說輯唐詩品。
units.en: As a young man Guixing studied under his fellow townsman Wu Ding and later studied under Yao Nai. Both his poetry and his ancient-style prose were accomplished by rule. He wrote memorial essays for presentation at court and a poetry collection, and he once compiled grades of Tang poetry according to Sikong Tu's critical theory.
units.literal: In his youth Guixing studied under Wu Ding of the same county, and later took Yao Nai as his teacher; his poetry and ancient-style prose were both methodical. He authored memorial essays presented to the throne and a collection of poems, and he also once compiled Tang poetry grades according to Sikong Tu's theory.

units.zh: 顧蓴，字南雅，江蘇吳縣人。
units.en: Gu Chun, whose courtesy name was Nanya, came from Wu County in Jiangsu.
units.literal: Gu Chun, style name Nanya, was a man of Wu County, Jiangsu.

units.zh: 嘉慶七年進士，選庶吉士，授編修。
units.en: He earned his jinshi degree in the seventh year of Jiaqing, entered the Hanlin Academy as a bachelor, and was appointed compiler.
units.literal: In the seventh year of Jiaqing he passed the jinshi examination, was selected as a bachelor of the Hanlin Academy, and was appointed compiler.

units.zh: 十七年，大考一等，擢侍讀。
units.en: In the seventeenth year he ranked in the top class in the great triennial evaluation and was promoted to reader-in-waiting.
units.literal: In the seventeenth year, in the great triennial evaluation he ranked first class and was promoted to reader-in-waiting.

units.zh: 督雲南學政，道經河南，見吏多貪墨，奸民充斥，密疏陳謂不早根治，恐釀巨患。
units.en: On his way to serve as educational commissioner of Yunnan he passed through Henan and found officials widely corrupt and rascals thick on the ground. In a confidential memorial he warned that failure to eradicate the problem early could breed disaster on a vast scale.
units.literal: While supervising education in Yunnan, passing through Henan he saw that many officials were corrupt and that wicked commoners filled the province; in a secret memorial he stated that if this were not rooted out early, it might breed a great calamity.

units.zh: 仁宗問樞臣，樞臣微其事，不以為意，明​​年遂有滑縣之亂。
units.en: Emperor Renzong consulted the Grand Council, but the council downplayed the report and took no notice. The following year the Huaxian rebellion erupted.
units.literal: The Renzong Emperor asked the Grand Council, but the council minimized the matter and paid it no heed; the next year the Huaxian uprising broke out.

units.zh: 在雲南，課士嚴而有恩，以正心術端行誼為首，次治經史、辨文體。
units.en: In Yunnan he taught the scholars with strict standards tempered by kindness, giving first place to moral discipline and upright conduct, and next to classical learning, historical study, and mastery of literary form.
units.literal: In Yunnan he instructed scholars strictly yet with kindness, putting rectification of mind and integrity of conduct first, and next the study of classics and histories and discrimination of literary forms.

units.zh: 按試所至，聞賢士必禮遇之，士風丕振。
units.en: On his inspection tours he always honored worthy scholars when he heard of them, and local scholarly morale rose sharply.
units.literal: Wherever he went on inspection tours, if he heard of worthy scholars he invariably treated them with courtesy, and scholarly custom was greatly revived.

units.zh: 任滿，充日講官。
units.en: When his term ended he was appointed to the daily lecture service at court.
units.literal: When his term ended he was appointed lecturer at the daily lectures.

units.zh: 二十五年，遷侍講學士。
units.en: In the twenty-fifth year he was promoted to expositor of the Hanlin Academy.
units.literal: In the twenty-fifth year he was transferred to expositor of the Hanlin Academy.

units.zh: 值宣宗初政，疏請停捐例。
units.en: At the outset of Daoguang's reign he memorialized asking that the sale of offices through monetary contributions be halted.
units.literal: At the beginning of the Daoguang Emperor's new rule he memorialized requesting suspension of the sale of offices by contribution.

units.zh: 再疏陳崇君德、正人心、飭官方三事。
units.en: In a second memorial he urged three reforms: strengthening the ruler's moral authority, rectifying public sentiment, and tightening official conduct.
units.literal: In a second memorial he set forth three matters: exalting the ruler's virtue, rectifying the people's hearts, and tightening official discipline.

units.zh: 上召對，嘉納其言。
units.en: The emperor summoned him for an audience and warmly accepted his recommendations.
units.literal: The emperor summoned him for audience and commended and accepted his words.

units.zh: 故事，大臣子弟不得充軍機章京，時值考選，許一體與試。
units.en: By longstanding rule, sons and younger brothers of senior ministers were barred from the Grand Council clerkships; but when examinations for selection were held at that time, they were allowed to compete on equal footing.
units.literal: By precedent, sons and younger brothers of great ministers could not serve as clerks in the Grand Council; at that time an examination for selection was under way, and they were permitted to compete on equal terms.

units.zh: 蓴謂貴介不宜與聞樞要，請收回成命。
units.en: Chun argued that men of privileged birth should not be admitted to confidential state business and asked that the concession be revoked.
units.literal: Chun said that men of high birth ought not to be privy to matters of state secrecy, and requested that the approved order be withdrawn.

units.zh: 事尋止。
units.en: The policy was soon abandoned.
units.literal: The matter was soon stopped.

units.zh: 左都御史松筠出為熱河都統，蓴上疏，謂松筠正人，宜留置左右，失上意，降編修，九歲不調。
units.en: When Left Censor-in-Chief Songyun was posted out as commander of Rehe, Chun memorialized that Songyun was a man of integrity who should be kept close to the throne. The memorial displeased the emperor; Chun was demoted to compiler and went nine years without a new appointment.
units.literal: When Left Censor-in-Chief Songyun was sent out as commander of Rehe, Chun memorialized, saying Songyun was an upright man and ought to be kept at the emperor's side; he lost imperial favor, was demoted to compiler, and for nine years received no transfer.

units.zh: 先是嘉慶中蓴在史館，撰和珅傳，及進禦，經他人竄改，和珅曾數因事被高宗詰責，並未載入傳。
units.en: Earlier, during the Jiaqing reign, Chun had been in the Historiography Office and drafted Heshen's biography. By the time it reached the throne others had altered it, omitting the many occasions on which Emperor Gaozong had censured Heshen for misconduct.
units.literal: Earlier, in the Jiaqing period, while Chun was in the Historiography Office he drafted the biography of Heshen; when it was presented to the throne it had been tampered with by others. Heshen had several times been rebuked by the Gaozong Emperor for various matters, yet none of this was entered in the biography.

units.zh: 仁宗怒其失實，嚴詔詰問。
units.en: Emperor Renzong, angered by the distortion, issued a stern edict demanding an account.
units.literal: The Renzong Emperor was angry at its lack of truth and issued a stern edict demanding explanation.

units.zh: 大臣以蓴原稿進，仁宗深是之，而奪竄改者官。
units.en: Senior ministers submitted Chun's original draft. Emperor Renzong strongly endorsed it and dismissed the officials who had altered the text.
units.literal: The great ministers submitted Chun's original draft; the Renzong Emperor deeply approved it, and stripped the tamperers of office.

units.zh: 宣宗一日閱實錄至此事，嘉蓴直筆，因言前保留松筠，必非阿私，特擢蓴右中允。
units.en: One day Emperor Daoguang, reading the Veritable Records, came upon the episode and praised Chun's honest historiography. Saying that Chun's earlier defense of Songyun could not have been sycophancy, he specially promoted Chun to right vice-director of the Secretariat.
units.literal: One day the Daoguang Emperor, reading the Veritable Records, came upon this affair and praised Chun's honest brush; he said that Chun's earlier effort to retain Songyun could not have been private flattery, and specially promoted Chun to right vice-director of the Secretariat.

units.zh: 未一歲，复侍講學士原職。
units.en: Within a year he was restored to his former rank as expositor of the Hanlin Academy.
units.literal: In less than a year he was restored to his former post as expositor of the Hanlin Academy.

units.zh: 時回疆張格爾亂甫定，蓴疏：「請於喀什噶爾沿邊增重兵，以控制安集延，杜回人窺伺；
units.en: At that time the Zhang Ge'er rebellion in the Western Regions had only just been suppressed. Chun memorialized: "Along the Kashgar frontier additional troops should be stationed to control Andijan and forestall Muslim probing;
units.literal: At that time the Zhang Ge'er rebellion in the Muslim borderlands had just been pacified; Chun memorialized: "I request that along the borders of Kashgar heavy troops be added to control Andijan and block Muslim reconnaissance;

units.zh: 又其地密邇英吉沙爾、葉爾羌、和闐，皆有水草可耕牧，宜募民屯田，為戰守備。
units.en: moreover the region borders Yengisar, Yarkand, and Khotan, where water and pasture support farming and grazing. Civilians should be recruited for frontier settlement to supply both defense and garrison needs.
units.literal: moreover, that region lies close to Yengisar, Yarkand, and Khotan, all of which have water and pasture suitable for farming and herding; commoners should be recruited to open military colonies as provisions for war and defense.

units.zh: 更請慎選大臣，無分滿、漢，務得讀書知大體有方略者任之，而以廉靜明信能拊循民、回者為之佐，庶可永永無事。」
units.en: He further urged that frontier governors be chosen with care from both Manchu and Han ranks—men of learning who grasp the larger strategic picture—and that they be assisted by officials who were upright, steady, trustworthy, and able to win over both Han settlers and Muslim communities. Only then, he argued, could the border remain permanently quiet."
units.literal: I further request that great ministers be chosen with care, without distinction between Manchu and Han, striving to obtain men who have read books, understand the larger pattern, and possess strategy to hold the post, while as assistants men who are incorrupt, tranquil, trustworthy, and able to stroke and guide Han and Muslim peoples—then perhaps there may be peace without end."

units.zh: 道光十一年，遷通政司副使。
units.en: In the eleventh year of Daoguang he was promoted to vice commissioner of the Office of Transmission.
units.literal: In the eleventh year of Daoguang he was transferred to vice commissioner of the Office of Transmission.

units.zh: 湖南北、江南、江西、浙江大水，蓴疏言：「饑民與鹽梟糾合易生事，鹽梟不盡去，終為巨患。
units.en: When severe floods hit Hunan, Hubei, the lower Yangzi, Jiangxi, and Zhejiang, Chun memorialized: "Hungry refugees who ally with salt smugglers can quickly turn violent. Unless smuggling rings are broken up, they will become a lasting scourge.
units.literal: Great floods struck Hunan, Hubei, Jiangnan, Jiangxi, and Zhejiang; Chun memorialized, saying: "Starving people joining with salt smugglers easily gives rise to trouble; if salt smugglers are not wholly removed, in the end they become a great calamity.

units.zh: 緩治之則養禍深，急治之則召禍速，欲禁其妄行，必先謀其生路。
units.en: Delay invites a deeper disaster; haste provokes an immediate one. To stop lawless conduct you must first secure lawful livelihoods.
units.literal: To treat the problem slowly nurtures a deep calamity; to treat it urgently summons swift calamity. If one wishes to forbid their reckless actions, one must first plan a livelihood for them.

units.zh: 現兩淮鹽場漂沒，三江、兩湖勢必仰給蘆、粵之鹽，宜聽民往販，隨時納課，收課後，不問所之，俟鹽產盛，丁力紓，即令課歸丁，不限疆域。」
units.en: With the Huai saltworks flooded, the Yangzi delta and the lake provinces would have to rely on salt from the reed-boil and Guangdong trades. He proposed allowing free private transport with duties paid en route, no questions asked after collection, and—once production recovered and transport costs eased—shifting tax burdens back onto producers without confining trade by region."
units.literal: At present the salt fields of Liang Huai have been inundated; the Three Rivers region and the two lake provinces will necessarily depend on salt from Lu and Guangdong. It is fitting to allow the people to go and trade, paying duty as they go; after duty is collected, do not inquire where the salt goes. Wait until salt production flourishes and the salt laborers are relieved, then let the duty return to the laborers and do not limit the territory."

units.zh: 事下所司，格未行。
units.en: The proposal was referred to the relevant agencies, but existing regulations blocked it and nothing was implemented.
units.literal: The matter was sent down to the responsible offices, but the regulations blocked it and it was not carried out.

units.zh: 蓴性嚴正，尚氣節，晚益負時望，從遊者眾，類能砥勵自立，滇士尤歸之，其秀異者至京師多就問業焉。
units.en: Chun was stern and upright, devoted to moral principle. In later life his reputation only grew, and a large circle of disciples learned self-discipline under him. Yunnan scholars revered him above all; their most talented men, once in Beijing, often sought him out for guidance.
units.literal: Chun's nature was stern and upright; he prized integrity; in his later years he bore ever greater public esteem. Those who studied under him were many, and for the most part they could sharpen themselves and stand on their own. Yunnan scholars especially looked to him; their outstanding men, on reaching the capital, often came to seek instruction from him.

units.zh: 十三年，卒。
units.en: In the thirteenth year he died.
units.literal: In the thirteenth year he died.

units.zh: 吳孝銘，字伯新，江蘇陽湖人。
units.en: Wu Xiaoming, whose courtesy name was Boxin, came from Yanghu in Jiangsu.
units.literal: Wu Xiaoming, style name Boxin, was a man of Yanghu, Jiangsu.

units.zh: 嘉慶十四年進士，選庶吉士，散館授工部主事，充軍機章京。
units.en: He earned his jinshi degree in the fourteenth year of Jiaqing, entered the Hanlin Academy as a bachelor, and on leaving the academy was appointed principal clerk in the Ministry of Works and then clerk in the Grand Council.
units.literal: In the fourteenth year of Jiaqing he passed the jinshi examination, was selected as a bachelor of the Hanlin Academy, and upon leaving the academy was appointed a principal clerk in the Ministry of Works and served as a Grand Council clerk.

units.zh: 十八年，林清之亂甫定，大軍會攻滑縣，孝銘從大臣行，參軍事。
units.en: In the eighteenth year, just after Lin Qing's rebellion was suppressed, imperial forces converged on Huaxian. Xiaoming accompanied the commanding ministers and assisted in military planning.
units.literal: In the eighteenth year, when the Lin Qing uprising had just been pacified, the great army converged to attack Huaxian; Xiaoming accompanied the great ministers on the campaign and took part in military affairs.

units.zh: 累遷郎中。
units.en: He rose in succession to the rank of director.
units.literal: He was promoted in succession to director.

units.zh: 道光中，回疆用兵，首逆張格爾潛逋未獲，議者欲以克復四城，分封回部酋長。
units.en: During the Daoguang reign, as campaigns continued in the Western Regions, the rebel leader Zhang Ge'er was still at large. Some officials proposed enfeoffing Muslim chieftains by parceling out the four recovered cities among them.
units.literal: In the Daoguang period, when troops were used in the Muslim borderlands, the chief rebel Zhang Ge'er remained at large uncaptured; some advisers wished to enfeoff Muslim tribal chiefs by dividing the four recovered cities among them.

units.zh: 孝銘密言於樞臣曰：「是可行於乾隆時，不可行於今日，行之邊患且益甚。」
units.en: Xiaoming told the Grand Council privately, "That might have worked in the Qianlong era, but not today. Carry it out and the frontier crisis will only deepen."
units.literal: Xiaoming said privately to the Grand Council: "This could be done in the Qianlong period; it cannot be done today. If done, border troubles will grow worse still."

units.zh: 議中止。
units.en: The plan was dropped.
units.literal: The proposal was halted.

units.zh: 張格爾旋就俘，賜花翎。
units.en: Zhang Ge'er was captured soon afterward, and Xiaoming was awarded the peacock feather insignia.
units.literal: Zhang Ge'er was soon captured, and Xiaoming was granted the peacock feather.

units.zh: 瀕年大水，江、浙、兩湖被災尤數，承回疆兵事後，度支大絀。
units.en: Year after year there were great floods; Jiangsu, Zhejiang, and the lake provinces suffered especially often. Coming on the heels of the Western Region campaigns, the treasury was severely depleted.
units.literal: Near the end of his life great floods occurred; Jiangsu, Zhejiang, and the two lake provinces suffered disaster especially often. This came after the border campaigns in the Muslim regions, and state revenue was severely strained.

units.zh: 戶部擬議，宗室日以蕃衍，衣食悉仰之官，耗財之大者，請自係出世祖以上子孫皆改為覺羅，為覺羅者以次遞革。
units.en: The Ministry of Revenue drafted a plan noting that the imperial clan was expanding daily while its members depended entirely on state stipends—a major fiscal drain. It proposed reclassifying all descendants of the Shizu Emperor and earlier as jueluo, with each new jueluo generation subject to successive reductions in rank and allowance.
units.literal: The Ministry of Revenue drafted a proposal: imperial clansmen daily multiplied, and food and clothing all depended on official provision—a great drain on finances. It requested that from descendants of the Shizu on upward all be changed to jueluo status, and that those made jueluo be reduced in rank in succession.

units.zh: 孝銘曰：「茲事當密陳，不宜顯言。
units.en: Xiaoming said, "This should be raised in confidence, not proclaimed openly.
units.literal: Xiaoming said: "This matter ought to be reported confidentially; it should not be stated openly.

units.zh: 法當緩更，不宜驟易。
units.en: Reform should proceed gradually, not all at once.
units.literal: The method ought to be changed slowly; it should not be altered abruptly.

units.zh: 宗室久受恩養，一旦降爵減糧令下即大困，因而呼籥，朝廷不得已，將必復之，是良法美意終於不行也。」
units.en: The clan has grown accustomed to imperial favor. The moment you cut ranks and rations they will be plunged into hardship and flood the court with petitions. Beijing will have no choice but to roll the policy back—so even a sound measure will never take hold."
units.literal: The imperial clan has long received imperial nurture; once an order lowering rank and reducing grain allotments is issued they will at once be greatly distressed, and thus will cry out in appeal; the court will have no choice but to restore them—so a good law and fine intention will in the end not be carried out."

units.zh: 部臣是其言，即使草奏上之。
units.en: The ministry officials accepted his advice and had him draft the memorial for submission.
units.literal: The ministry officials approved his words and had him draft the memorial to present it.

units.zh: 歷鴻臚寺少卿、光祿寺少卿、通政司參議、順天府丞，仍留直軍機處。
units.en: He rose through vice minister of the Court of State Ceremonial, vice minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, councillor of the Office of Transmission, and vice prefect of Shuntian, all while retaining his Grand Council post.
units.literal: He served in succession as vice minister of the Court of State Ceremonial, vice minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, councillor of the Office of Transmission, and vice prefect of Shuntian Prefecture, while remaining on duty in the Grand Council.

units.zh: 十四年，擢太僕寺卿，再遷宗人府丞。
units.en: In the fourteenth year he was promoted to minister of the Imperial Stud and soon afterward to vice minister of the Imperial Clan Court.
units.literal: In the fourteenth year he was promoted to minister of the Court of the Imperial Stud and again transferred to vice minister of the Imperial Clan Court.

units.zh: 孝銘前後在樞廷二十馀年，練於掌故，持議悉合機宜；
units.en: Xiaoming spent more than twenty years in the Grand Council, mastered institutional precedent, and framed proposals that consistently matched the moment;
units.literal: Xiaoming served in the Council for more than twenty years, was practiced in precedent, and his proposals all accorded with the opportune moment;

units.zh: 屢膺文衡，有公明稱。
units.en: he presided over literary examinations many times and was known for impartial judgment.
units.literal: he repeatedly undertook literary examinations and had a reputation for fairness and clarity.

units.zh: 母憂，以毀致疾，服闋，至京。
units.en: While mourning his mother he fell ill from grief. When mourning ended he returned to the capital.
units.literal: During mourning for his mother he fell ill from grief; when mourning ended he reached the capital.

units.zh: 尋乞病歸，卒於家。
units.en: He soon resigned on grounds of illness, returned home, and died there.
units.literal: Soon he begged leave on grounds of illness and returned home, dying at his residence.

units.zh: 陳鴻，字午橋，浙江錢塘人。
units.en: Chen Hong, whose courtesy name was Wuqiao, came from Qiantang in Zhejiang.
units.literal: Chen Hong, style name Wuqiao, was a man of Qiantang, Zhejiang.

units.zh: 嘉慶十四年進士，選庶吉士，授編修。
units.en: He earned his jinshi degree in the fourteenth year of Jiaqing, entered the Hanlin Academy as a bachelor, and was appointed compiler.
units.literal: In the fourteenth year of Jiaqing he passed the jinshi examination, was selected as a bachelor of the Hanlin Academy, and was appointed compiler.

units.zh: 遷御史，剛直有聲。
units.en: He was promoted to censor and gained renown for blunt integrity.
units.literal: He was transferred to censor and had a reputation for blunt uprightness.

units.zh: 典試山西還，力陳驛站煩擾，請申定例，肅郵政。
units.en: On returning from his Shanxi examination assignment he forcefully memorialized on abuses at courier stations, asking that regulations be clarified and enforced to restore the postal system.
units.literal: Returning from serving as chief examiner in Shanxi, he forcefully memorialized on the vexation of courier stations, requesting clarification and enforcement of the regulations to rectify the postal service.

units.zh: 二十五年，疏陳浙江水利，略曰：「杭城地當省會，用上下兩塘之水，溉仁和、錢塘、海寧之田數万馀頃。
units.en: In the twenty-fifth year he memorialized on Zhejiang waterworks, writing in part: "Hangzhou, seat of the provincial capital, relies on the upper and lower reservoir systems to irrigate tens of thousands of qing of farmland in Renhe, Qiantang, and Haining.
units.literal: In the twenty-fifth year he memorialized on Zhejiang water conservancy, stating in summary: "Hangzhou, as the seat of the provincial capital, uses the waters of the upper and lower ponds to irrigate tens of thousands of qing of fields in Renhe, Qiantang, and Haining.

units.zh: 源出西湖，近廢不治。
units.en: The source is West Lake, which in recent years has been neglected and left unrepaired.
units.literal: The source issues from West Lake, which in recent times has been abandoned and not maintained.

units.zh: 水淤葑積，塘河津耗，夏旱少雨，上塘枯涸，菑害尤劇。
units.en: Silt and duckweed choked the channels; pond rivers and sluice gates fell into ruin. In summer droughts the upper reservoirs ran dry and crop losses were especially severe.
units.literal: Water silted up and duckweed accumulated; pond rivers and sluices were depleted; in summer droughts with little rain the upper pond dried up, and crop damage was especially severe.

units.zh: 海寧長安鎮號產米之鄉，許村黃灣場為產鹽之地，杭、嘉、湖、寧、紹諸郡賴是挽運。
units.en: Chang'an in Haining was renowned for grain; the Huangwan salt works at Xucun supplied salt transport on which Hangzhou, Jiaxing, Huzhou, Ningbo, and Shaoxing all depended.
units.literal: Chang'an Town in Haining was famed as a rice-producing district; Huangwan Salt Field at Xucun was a salt-producing place on which Hang, Jia, Hu, Ning, and Shao prefectures relied for transport and haulage.

units.zh: 擬請仿江蘇浚吳淞例，歸民間按畝出貲，並飭疆臣躬履屬境，凡堤塘徬壩，悉復舊制，俾農田旱潦有備。」
units.en: He proposed following Jiangsu's Wusong dredging model, funding repairs through local contributions assessed by acreage, and requiring provincial officials to inspect their territories in person. Every dike, pond, and embankment should be restored to its former standard so that fields would be secure against both drought and flood."
units.literal: It is proposed to follow the Jiangsu precedent of dredging the Wusong River, having the people contribute funds by the mu of land, and also ordering frontier officials in person to traverse their jurisdictions; wherever dikes, ponds, and embankments exist, all old systems should be restored, so that farmland may be prepared against drought and flood."

units.zh: 又請：「北省多闢水田，兼收秔稻之利，庶使畿輔為沃野，無凶年。」
units.en: He also urged opening more paddy fields in the north to capture the benefits of both long- and short-grain rice, turning the capital region into rich farmland free of famine years."
units.literal: He also requested: "In the northern provinces many fields should be opened to paddy, jointly reaping the profit of both indica and japonica rice, so that the capital region may become fertile fields without years of famine."

units.zh: 皆被採納。
units.en: Both proposals were adopted.
units.literal: All were adopted.

units.zh: 道光初年，疏陳浙鹺不綱，請裁鹽政，歸巡撫兼理，令整頓緝私，嚴禁掣規重斤科派供應諸弊，如議行。
units.en: Early in Daoguang he memorialized that Zhejiang's salt monopoly was poorly coordinated, proposing abolition of the salt commissioner's office, placing oversight under the governor, and a crackdown on smuggling together with abuses such as rule-bending, overweight charges, and illicit levies for supplies. The reforms were enacted as he proposed.
units.literal: In the early Daoguang period he memorialized that Zhejiang salt administration lacked unified control, requesting abolition of the salt commissioner, return of management to the governor's concurrent charge, and orders to rectify suppression of smuggling and strictly forbid such abuses as skimming rules, overweight levies, and supply exactions; it was carried out as proposed.

units.zh: 糾劾工部弊竇最多，不避權貴。
units.en: He impeached the Ministry of Works, where corruption was rife, without sparing the powerful.
units.literal: He impeached the Ministry of Works, where malpractices were most numerous, and did not avoid the powerful and noble.

units.zh: 遷給事中。
units.en: He was promoted to supervising secretary.
units.literal: He was transferred to supervising secretary.

units.zh: 二年，奉命稽察銀庫，其妻固賢明，曰：「今而後可送妾輩歸矣！」
units.en: In the second year he was ordered to audit the silver vault. His wife, a woman of notable sense, said, "From this day forward you may send your concubines home!"
units.literal: In the second year he was ordered to inspect the silver vault; his wife, who was by nature worthy and clear-minded, said, "From now on you may send your concubines back!"

units.zh: 驚問之，曰：「銀庫美差也，苟為所染，暱君者麕至。
units.en: Alarmed, he asked why. She replied, "The silver vault is a lucrative post. Once you are compromised, flatterers will swarm in.
units.literal: Startled, he asked why; she said, "The silver vault is a fine appointment; if you are stained by it, those close to you will flock in.

units.zh: 禍且不測，妾不忍見君菜市也。」
units.en: Disaster will follow—and I cannot bear to see you led to the execution ground."
units.literal: Calamity will then be beyond reckoning; your wife cannot bear to see you on the execution ground."

units.zh: 鴻指天自誓，禁絕賂遺。
units.en: Hong swore an oath to Heaven and refused all gifts.
units.literal: Hong pointed to Heaven and swore, forbidding all bribes.

units.zh: 中庭已列花數盆，急揮去，墮地盆碎，中有藏鏹，益聳懼。
units.en: Flower pots had already been placed in the courtyard. He ordered them removed at once; they fell and broke, revealing concealed silver inside. His fear only deepened.
units.literal: Several flower pots had already been set out in the central courtyard; he hurriedly had them removed; they fell to the ground and the pots shattered, and hidden silver was found within—he was all the more alarmed.

units.zh: 遂奏庫衡年久鐵陷，請敕工部選精鐵易之。
units.en: He then memorialized that the vault scales, worn over many years, had iron sunk into them, and asked the Ministry of Works to supply new iron of superior quality.
units.literal: He then memorialized that the vault's scales, after many years, had iron sunk into them, and requested that the Ministry of Works select fine iron to replace them.

units.zh: 送庫日，責成管庫大臣率科道庫員較驗，然後啟用。
units.en: On the day the new scales were delivered, he required the vault minister to lead censors and clerks in joint verification before they were placed in service.
units.literal: On the day the scales were delivered to the vault, he charged the minister in charge of the vault to lead the censors and clerks in comparison and verification before they were put into use.

units.zh: 禁挪壓餉銀、空白出納及劈鞘諸弊。
units.en: He banned diverting troop-pay silver, keeping blank ledgers for receipts and disbursements, and shaving silver from ingot sheaths.
units.literal: He forbade the abuses of diverting and withholding pay silver, blank receipts for receipts and disbursements, and splitting ingot sheaths.

units.zh: 庫吏百計餂之，不動。
units.en: Vault clerks tried every trick to win him over, but he would not budge.
units.literal: Vault clerks used a hundred schemes to entice him; he did not move.

units.zh: 復請戶部逐月移送收銀總簿，別立放銀簿，鈐用印信，以資考覈。
units.en: He also asked the Ministry of Revenue to forward the master receipt ledger each month, keep a separate disbursement ledger, and require official seals on both to enable auditing.
units.literal: He further requested that the Ministry of Revenue each month transfer the general ledger of silver received, separately establish a ledger of silver disbursed, affix seals, to supply material for audit.

units.zh: 先是御史趙佩湘馭吏嚴，其死也，論者疑其中毒。
units.en: Earlier, Censor Zhao Peixiang had ruled the clerks with an iron hand. After his death, many suspected he had been poisoned.
units.literal: Earlier the censor Zhao Peixiang had controlled clerks strictly; when he died, those who discussed the matter suspected he had been poisoned.

units.zh: 鴻蒞庫，勺水不敢飲。
units.en: When Hong took charge of the vault, he would not drink even a spoonful of water offered there.
units.literal: When Hong took charge of the vault, he dared not drink a spoonful of water.

units.zh: 出督雲南學政，奏革陋規，嚴束書吏，弊風頓革。
units.en: Posted as Yunnan educational commissioner, he memorialized to abolish entrenched abuses, tightened control over clerks, and corrupt practices were quickly rooted out.
units.literal: He went out to supervise Yunnan education, memorialized to abolish vulgar regulations, strictly bound clerks, and corrupt practices were suddenly reformed.

units.zh: 遷通政司參議，卒於官。
units.en: He was promoted to vice commissioner of the Transmission Office and died in that post.
units.literal: He was transferred to vice commissioner of the Transmission Office and died in office.

units.zh: 鄂木順額，字复亭，鈕祜祿氏，滿洲正藍旗人。
units.en: E Mushune, whose courtesy name was Futing, belonged to the Niohuru clan and came from the Manchu Plain Blue Banner.
units.literal: E Mushune, style name Futing, of the Niohuru clan, was a man of the Manchu Plain Blue Banner.

units.zh: 父明安泰，江蘇按察使。
units.en: His father Ming Antai had served as surveillance commissioner of Jiangsu.
units.literal: His father Ming Antai was Jiangsu surveillance commissioner.

units.zh: 鄂木順額，嘉慶二十五年進士，選庶吉士，授編修，累遷右庶子。
units.en: E Mushune earned his jinshi degree in the twenty-fifth year of Jiaqing, entered the Hanlin Academy as a bachelor, became a compiler, and rose in succession to right vice-director of the Supervisorate of Education.
units.literal: E Mushune, in the twenty-fifth year of Jiaqing passed the jinshi examination, was selected as a bachelor of the Hanlin Academy, was appointed compiler, and was promoted in succession to right vice-director of the Supervisorate of Education.

units.zh: 道光四年，大考一等，擢翰林院侍講學士，遷少詹事。
units.en: In the fourth year of Daoguang he ranked first class in the grand examination, was promoted to Hanlin expositor, and became junior commissioner of the Supervisorate of Education.
units.literal: In the fourth year of Daoguang, in the grand examination he placed first class, was promoted to Hanlin expositor, and was transferred to junior commissioner of the Supervisorate of Education.

units.zh: 扈從東巡，命分視御道，內監前驅者多率意馳踐，鄂木順額執而鞭之，則愬於御前。
units.en: On the eastern tour he was assigned to inspect sections of the imperial road. Many eunuch outriders rode recklessly and trampled it. E Mushune seized and whipped them, and they appealed to the emperor.
units.literal: Accompanying the eastern tour, he was ordered to inspect the imperial road in sections; many eunuch outriders rode willfully and trampled it. E Mushune seized and whipped them, and they complained before the emperor.

units.zh: 召問，鄂木順額對曰：「關外地與關內異，先驅蹂踐則路壞，慮驚乘輿。
units.en: Called in and questioned, E Mushune answered: "The terrain beyond the passes is not like that within them. If outriders trample the road it will be ruined, and I feared alarming the imperial carriage.
units.literal: Summoned and questioned, E Mushune replied: "Land beyond the passes differs from within the passes. If outriders trample and tread, the road will be ruined, and I fear startling the imperial carriage.

units.zh: 且御道非大駕不得行，臣不敢不執法。」
units.en: Moreover, only the imperial procession may use the imperial road. I dared not fail to enforce the law."
units.literal: Moreover the imperial road may not be traveled except by the great procession; your servant dared not fail to enforce the law."

units.zh: 上韙之。
units.en: The emperor approved his conduct.
units.literal: The emperor approved him.

units.zh: 命為湖南學政，以在母憂，引禮力辭。
units.en: He was appointed educational commissioner of Hunan, but as he was in mourning for his mother he cited ritual propriety and firmly declined.
units.literal: He was appointed Hunan educational commissioner; as he was in mourning for his mother, he cited ritual and forcefully declined.

units.zh: 服闋，督安徽學政，遷光祿寺卿。
units.en: When mourning ended he served as educational commissioner of Anhui and was promoted to Minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.
units.literal: When mourning ended he supervised Anhui education and was transferred to Minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.

units.zh: 十一年，大雨江溢，學政駐當塗，鄂木順額捐廉以賑，督守令勸捐，士民踴躍。
units.en: In the eleventh year heavy rains flooded the river. The educational commissioner was stationed at Dangtu. E Mushune donated his official salary for relief, urged prefects and magistrates to solicit contributions, and gentry and commoners responded enthusiastically.
units.literal: In the eleventh year great rain caused the river to overflow; the educational commissioner was stationed at Dangtu. E Mushune donated his official salary for relief, supervised prefects and magistrates to encourage donations, and gentry and commoners leaped forward eagerly.

units.zh: 知縣趙汝和盡心民事，而戇直忤大吏，調為鄉試同考官。
units.en: Magistrate Zhao Ruhe devoted himself to local affairs, but his blunt integrity offended senior officials, and he was transferred to serve as associate examiner for the provincial examination.
units.literal: Magistrate Zhao Ruhe devoted himself to the people's affairs, but his blunt uprightness offended great officials, and he was transferred to be associate examiner for the provincial examination.

units.zh: 鄂木順額堅留治賑，事得辦，後上聞。
units.en: E Mushune insisted on keeping him for relief work. The effort succeeded, and the matter was later reported to the throne.
units.literal: E Mushune firmly retained him for relief work; the matter was accomplished, and later it was reported above.

units.zh: 宣宗以為賢，期滿留任，遷大理寺卿。
units.en: Emperor Xuanzong judged him worthy. When his term ended he was kept in post and promoted to Minister of the Court of Judicial Review.
units.literal: Emperor Xuanzong regarded him as worthy; when his term ended he was retained in office and was transferred to Minister of the Court of Judicial Review.

units.zh: 十二年，鄉試，往江寧考錄遺才，卒於試院。
units.en: In the twelfth year, while presiding over the provincial examination at Jiangning to select overlooked talent, he died in the examination compound.
units.literal: In the twelfth year, during the provincial examination, he went to Jiangning to examine and record overlooked talent and died in the examination compound.

units.zh: 鄂木順額以氣節自勵，在滿洲京僚中稱最。
units.en: E Mushune disciplined himself by moral integrity and was regarded as foremost among Manchu officials in the capital.
units.literal: E Mushune took moral fortitude as his discipline; among Manchu capital officials he was called the foremost.

units.zh: 大學士松筠尤重之，曰：「君光明挺直，行且大用，原自愛。」
units.en: Grand Secretary Songyun held him in special regard and said, "You are bright and upright. You will soon be greatly employed—please take care of yourself."
units.literal: Grand Secretary Songyun especially valued him, saying: "You are bright, upright, and straight; soon you will be greatly employed—please take care of yourself."

units.zh: 為英和門下士，在翰林，非有故不通謁。
units.en: He had been a disciple of Yinghe. In the Hanlin Academy he paid calls on no one without a proper reason.
units.literal: He was a disciple of Yinghe; in the Hanlin, without a special reason he did not pay calls.

units.zh: 及英和謫戍，獨送至數十里外。
units.en: When Yinghe was banished to the frontier, he alone escorted him several tens of li on his way.
units.literal: When Yinghe was banished to border garrison, he alone escorted him several tens of li beyond.

units.zh: 英和太息曰：「吾愧不知人，平日何曾好待君耶？」
units.en: Yinghe sighed deeply and said, "I am ashamed that I failed to know a man of worth. How often did I ever treat you well in ordinary times?"
units.literal: Yinghe sighed deeply and said: "I am ashamed that I did not know men—how ever did I treat you well in ordinary times?"

units.zh: 嘗謁掌院學士玉麟，閽人弗為通，怒叱曰：「英相國獲罪，即若曹為之，奈何猶不知儆！」
units.en: Once he called on Academician-in-Chief Yulin, but the gatekeeper refused to announce him. He shouted in anger, "Grand Councilor Ying was condemned—and your sort brought it about! Why have you still not learned to take warning!"
units.literal: Once he called on Academician-in-Chief Yulin; the gatekeeper would not announce him. He angrily shouted: "Grand Councilor Ying was condemned—that was because of your kind! Why do you still not know to take warning!"

units.zh: 翼日，玉麟自往謝。
units.en: The next day Yulin went in person to apologize.
units.literal: The next day Yulin went in person to apologize.

units.zh: 徐法績，字熙庵，陝西涇陽人。
units.en: Xu Faji, whose courtesy name was Xi'an, came from Jingyang in Shaanxi.
units.literal: Xu Faji, style name Xi'an, was a man of Jingyang, Shaanxi.

units.zh: 嘉慶二十二年進士，選庶吉士，授編修。
units.en: He earned his jinshi degree in the twenty-second year of Jiaqing, entered the Hanlin Academy as a bachelor, and was appointed compiler.
units.literal: In the twenty-second year of Jiaqing he passed the jinshi examination, was selected as a bachelor of the Hanlin Academy, and was appointed compiler.

units.zh: 以親老歸養，家居十年。
units.en: When his parents grew old he returned home to care for them and remained there ten years.
units.literal: Because his parents were aged he returned home to support them and lived at home ten years.

units.zh: 道光九年，遷御史，謂諫臣當識大體，不宜毛舉細故瀆上聽，致久浸生厭。
units.en: In the ninth year of Daoguang he was promoted to censor. He argued that remonstrating officials should grasp the larger pattern, not weary the throne with petty complaints, lest constant triviality breed contempt.
units.literal: In the ninth year of Daoguang he was transferred to censor and said that remonstrating officials ought to grasp the larger pattern, should not pick petty matters and weary the emperor's ear, lest long immersion produce disgust.

units.zh: 疏陳求人才、捐文法、重守令、繩貪墨四事。
units.en: He memorialized on four measures: recruiting talent, easing formalistic regulations, strengthening prefects and magistrates, and punishing corruption.
units.literal: In a memorial he set forth four matters: seeking talent, setting aside formalistic law, emphasizing prefects and magistrates, and restraining the corrupt.

units.zh: 會直隸、河南地震成災，劾罷監司不職者二人。
units.en: When earthquakes struck Zhili and Henan and brought disaster, he impeached and removed two incompetent provincial supervisors.
units.literal: At the time earthquakes in Zhili and Henan became disasters; he impeached and dismissed two incompetent surveillance and circuit officials.

units.zh: 遷給事中，稽察銀庫，無所染。
units.en: He was promoted to supervising secretary, audited the silver vault, and remained uncorrupted.
units.literal: He was transferred to supervising secretary, inspected the silver vault, and was stained by nothing.

units.zh: 十二年，分校會試，同官與吏乘隙為奸，匿雲南餉銀，法績出闈亟按之，謀始沮。
units.en: In the twelfth year, while serving as divisional examiner for the metropolitan examination, colleagues and clerks seized an opening for fraud and concealed Yunnan pay silver. Faji left the examination compound and investigated at once, and the plot was thwarted.
units.literal: In the twelfth year he served as divisional examiner for the metropolitan examination; colleagues and clerks seized an opening for knavery and concealed Yunnan pay silver. Faji left the examination compound and immediately investigated; the plot was finally thwarted.

units.zh: 典試湖南，其副病歿，獨專校閱，遍搜遺卷，拔取多知名士，而得於遺卷者六人，大學士左宗棠其首也。
units.en: He presided over the Hunan provincial examination. When his deputy died of illness he undertook the reading alone, searched every leftover paper, and selected many men who later became famous. Six were found among the rejected papers, foremost among them Grand Secretary Zuo Zongtang.
units.literal: He presided over the Hunan examination; his deputy died of illness. He alone specialized in examination reading, searched leftover papers everywhere, and selected many famous scholars. Six were obtained from leftover papers, Grand Secretary Zuo Zongtang being the first.

units.zh: 以薦赴東河，學習河工，週曆兩岸，詳詢利弊，著錄為東河要略一篇。
units.en: On recommendation he went to the Eastern River conservancy, studied hydraulic engineering, toured both banks, investigated advantages and drawbacks in detail, and recorded his findings in a monograph entitled Essentials of the Eastern River.
units.literal: On recommendation he went to the Eastern River, studied river works, toured both banks in circuit, inquired minutely into advantages and harms, and wrote it down as one piece entitled Essentials of the Eastern River.

units.zh: 十四年，遷太常寺少卿。
units.en: In the fourteenth year he was promoted to vice minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.
units.literal: In the fourteenth year he was transferred to vice minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.

units.zh: 尋以病乞歸，逾二年卒。
units.en: He soon resigned on grounds of illness and returned home, dying a little more than two years later.
units.literal: Soon he begged leave on grounds of illness and returned home; after more than two years he died.

units.zh: 論曰：鮑桂星、顧蓴以鯁直獲譴，卒見諒於明主，蓴之建白，尤卓卓矣。
units.en: The commentators say: Bao Guixing and Gu Chun were punished for blunt integrity, yet in the end won understanding from an enlightened sovereign. Chun's proposals were especially outstanding.
units.literal: The commentary says: Bao Guixing and Gu Chun were punished for blunt uprightness, yet in the end were understood by a clear sovereign; Chun's proposals were especially outstanding.

units.zh: 吳孝銘通達政體，鄂木順額樸誠持正，陳鴻、徐法績清操相繼，冀挽頹風，而庫藏大獄，卒發於十數年之間，甚矣實心除弊之罕覯其人也！
units.en: Wu Xiaoming mastered the workings of government; E Mushune was plainspoken, sincere, and upright; Chen Hong and Xu Faji upheld integrity in succession, hoping to reverse a declining age. Yet the great vault scandals finally erupted within a dozen years. How seldom does one meet a man who earnestly sets out to root out abuses!
units.literal: Wu Xiaoming mastered government forms; E Mushune was plain and honest in uprightness; Chen Hong and Xu Faji's integrity succeeded one another—they hoped to reverse declining winds—but the great vault cases finally broke out within a dozen or so years. How rare are those who earnestly remove abuses!

units.zh: 嘉慶初元，再舉千叟宴，朝鮮、安南、暹羅、廓爾喀額爾德尼王吉爾巴納足塔畢噶爾瑪薩九叩，「跪奉大皇帝前：竊小臣聞湖南教匪滋事，致天威震怒，遣兵剿除。
units.en: At the beginning of the Jiaqing reign, the banquet of a thousand elders was held again; Korea, Annam, Siam, and the king of Gorkha, Girbanazutabigarmasa, performed nine kowtows, kneeling to address the Great Emperor: "Your humble subject heard that bandits in Hunan provoked the imperial wrath and troops were dispatched to suppress them.
units.literal: At the beginning of the Jiaqing reign, the banquet of a thousand elders was held again; Korea, Annam, Siam, and the king of Gorkha, Girbanazutabigarmasa, performed nine kowtows, kneeling to address the Great Emperor: "Your humble subject heard that bandits in Hunan provoked the imperial wrath and troops were dispatched to suppress them.

units.zh: 二十一年，英復遣使來貢，執事者告以須行拜跪禮，司當冬等遂稱疾不入覲，帝怒，諭遣歸國，罷筵宴賜物。
units.en: In the twenty-first year, England again sent envoys to present tribute; the officials told them they must perform the kneeling and kowtowing rites; Staunton and others then claimed illness and refused audience; the emperor in anger ordered them sent home and canceled the banquet and gifts.
units.literal: In the twenty-first year, England again sent envoys to present tribute; the officials told them they must perform the kneeling and kowtowing rites; Staunton and others then claimed illness and refused audience; the emperor in anger ordered them sent home and canceled the banquet and gifts.

units.zh: 司空圖、李敬義三度除官，養望不至，咸宜屏黜，以勸事君者。」
units.en: Sikong Tu and Li Jingyi have been appointed three times yet nursed their reputations and never reported—all should be dismissed to encourage loyal service."
units.literal: Sikong Tu and Li Jingyi have been appointed three times yet nursed their reputation and did not come—all should be removed from office to encourage those who serve their lord."

units.zh: 司空圖亦追停前詔，任從閑適。
units.en: Sikong Tu's prior appointment was also revoked, and he was left to his leisure.
units.literal: Sikong Tu also had his prior edict revoked and was allowed to follow leisure as he pleased.

units.zh: 九月壬寅，敕前大中大夫、尚書兵部侍郎、賜紫金魚袋司空圖放還中條山。
units.en: On the renyin day of the ninth month, an edict released former Vice Minister of War Sikong Tu, bearer of the purple-gold fish tally, to return to Mount Zhongtiao.
units.literal: On the renyin day of the ninth month, an edict released former Grand Master of Palace Attendance, Vice Minister of War in the Secretariat, bearer of the purple-gold fish tally Sikong Tu to return to Mount Zhongtiao.

units.zh: 圖，唐史有傳。
units.en: Tu has a biography in the Tang histories.
units.literal: Tu has a biography in the Tang histories.

units.zh: 四年，高宗崩，大學士和珅得罪，仁宗以福長安阿附，逮下獄，奪爵，籍其家。
units.en: In 1799, after Qianlong's death, Heshen fell; Jiaqing arrested Fuchang'an for siding with Heshen, stripped his rank, and seized his property.
units.literal: In the fourth year, when the Gaozong Emperor died, Grand Secretary Heshen was condemned; the Renzong Emperor, holding that Fuchang'an had fawned on Heshen, had him arrested, stripped of rank, and his property confiscated.

units.zh: 諸大臣議用朋黨律坐立斬，上命改監候，而賜和珅死，使監福長安詣和珅死所跪視。
units.en: Ministers proposed decapitation under the faction law; the emperor commuted it to imprisonment, executed Heshen, and made Fuchang'an watch.
units.literal: The ministers proposed sentencing by the statute on faction, which meant immediate decapitation; the emperor ordered imprisonment awaiting execution instead, and while granting Heshen death ordered Fuchang'an brought to kneel where Heshen died and watch.

units.zh: 瀛工文章，與姚鼐相推重，體亦相近雲。
units.en: Ying excelled at prose and held Yao Nai in mutual esteem; their styles were much alike.
units.literal: Ying was skilled in literary composition and mutually esteemed with Yao Nai; their styles were also similar.

units.zh: 嘉慶中，從都統慶溥言，撤回厄魯特人牧廠。
units.en: Under Jiaqing, at banner commander Qing Pu's urging, the Oirat pasture was withdrawn.
units.literal: During Jiaqing, following banner commander Qing Pu's statement, the Oirat people's pasture was withdrawn.

units.zh: 普恭十月丁亥遷。松筠左都御史。十一月癸巳遷。誠存左都御史。甲戌遷。文孚左都御史。
units.en: On the dinghai day of the tenth month, 普恭 was transferred. 松筠: Left Censor-in-Chief. On the guisi day of the eleventh month, was transferred. 誠存: Left Censor-in-Chief. On the jiaxu day, was transferred. 文孚: Left Censor-in-Chief.
units.literal: On the dinghai day of the tenth month, 普恭 was transferred. 松筠: Left Censor-in-Chief. On the guisi day of the eleventh month, was transferred. 誠存: Left Censor-in-Chief. On the jiaxu day, was transferred. 文孚: Left Censor-in-Chief.

units.zh: 嘉慶二十五年庚辰
units.en: Twenty-fifth year of Jiaqing, 1820, gengchen
units.literal: Twenty-fifth year of Jiaqing, gengchen

units.zh: 同治五年，閩浙總督左宗棠言：「閩省武營捐班太多，應嚴加區別，以肅軍政。」
units.en: In Tongzhi 5, Fujian-Zhejiang Governor-General Zuo Zongtang said: "Fujian has too many military purchase quotas; they should be strictly distinguished to restore military discipline."
units.literal: In the fifth year of Tongzhi, Fujian-Zhejiang Governor-General Zuo Zongtang said: "Fujian military camp contribution quotas are too numerous; strict distinction should be made to rectify military administration."

units.zh: 並請罷武職捐，從之。
units.en: He also requested abolishing military purchases; the request was granted.
units.literal: He also requested abolishing military contributions; this was followed.

units.zh: 五年，允英和之請，以八旗圈馬四百匹，改撥巡捕營，令滿洲、蒙古馬兵演習騎射，春秋二季，步軍統領會同左右翼總兵簡閱，三年後親臨大閱，八年，令那彥成等回疆增設防兵，籌給餉糈，議定操兵章程，並於喀什噶爾防兵內，抽練二千名，伊犁滿兵亦勤習騎射，由參贊大臣及總兵督操。
units.en: In year 5 Yinghe's request was granted: four hundred banner pasture horses were reassigned to the patrol brigade for Manchu and Mongol cavalry archery, inspected each spring and autumn by the foot-soldiers commandant with the wing regional commanders; after three years the emperor would personally hold a grand review. In year 8 Nayancheng and others expanded Muslim-frontier garrisons, funded them, set drill rules, picked two thousand Kashgar men to train, and ordered diligent archery drill for Ili Manchu under the resident and regional commander.
units.literal: In the fifth year, Yinghe's request was granted: four hundred horses from the Eight Banners' pastures were reassigned to the Patrol Brigade; Manchu and Mongol cavalry were ordered to practice mounted archery; in spring and autumn the foot-soldiers commandant together with left- and right-wing regional commanders conducted inspection; three years later the emperor would personally attend a grand inspection. In the eighth year, Nayancheng and others were ordered to increase frontier garrison troops in the Muslim regions, arrange pay and grain, fix drill regulations, and select two thousand from Kashgar garrison troops for drill; Ili Manchu troops were also to practice mounted archery diligently, supervised by the imperial resident and regional commander.

units.zh: 道光九年，回疆敉定，上太后徽號，緬甸國王遣使進金葉表，創舉也。
units.en: In the ninth year of Daoguang, after the Muslim frontier was pacified and honorific titles were conferred upon the empress dowager, the king of Burma sent envoys presenting a memorial on gold leaf—a first.
units.literal: In the ninth year of Daoguang, after the Muslim frontier was pacified and honorific titles were conferred upon the empress dowager, the king of Burma sent envoys presenting a memorial on gold leaf—a first.

units.zh: 故事，琉球間歲一貢，至十九年，詔改四年為期。
units.en: By precedent, Ryukyu paid tribute every other year; in the nineteenth year an edict changed the interval to four years.
units.literal: By precedent, Ryukyu paid tribute every other year; in the nineteenth year an edict changed the interval to four years.

units.zh: 報可。
units.en: The request was approved.
units.literal: The report was approved.

units.zh: 值大軍徵張格爾，調駐嘉峪關治軍需。
units.en: When the empire launched its campaign against Jahangir Khoja, he was stationed at Jiayuguan to manage military supplies.
units.literal: When the great army campaigned against Jahangir Khoja, he was transferred to station at Jiayuguan to manage military supplies.

units.zh: 道光二年，補陝西鳳邠道。
units.en: In Daoguang 2 he was posted to the Feng-Bin circuit in Shaanxi.
units.literal: In the second year of Daoguang he was assigned to the Feng-Bin circuit of Shaanxi.

units.zh: 高宗又以舊記星紀，間有疏漏，御製璣衡撫辰儀，重加測候。
units.en: Qianlong, finding gaps in older star catalogs, built the Armillary Sphere and Chronographic Instrument and remeasured the sky.
units.literal: The Gaozong Emperor again, because old star records had occasional gaps, personally made the Armillary Sphere and Chronographic Instrument and took new observations.

units.zh: 乾隆六十年以後，國史無徵，則從闕焉。
units.en: After Qianlong 60 the Veritable Records offer no material, so the account stops there.
units.literal: After Qianlong year 60 the National History has no testimony, and those years are therefore omitted.

units.zh: 今以康熙年間實測各省及諸蒙古高度、偏度，並乾隆時憲所增省分，與回疆部落、兩金川土司等，晝夜永短，節氣早晚，推得高度、偏度備列焉。
units.en: Here Kangxi surveys, Qianlong additions, Xinjiang, and Jinchuan observations yield revised polar altitudes and longitudinal offsets.
units.literal: Now from Kangxi-era actual surveys of each province and Mongol banners, plus provinces added in the Qianlong Time Constitution, together with Muslim borderland tribes and the two Jinchuan chieftaincies — day and night length, solar-term timing — heights and offsets are derived and fully listed.

units.zh: 有清統一區夏，聖聖相承。
units.en: The Qing unified China, one sage emperor following another.
units.literal: The Qing unified All-under-Heaven, sage succeeding sage.

units.zh: 迨平定回疆及兩金川，復令重度裏差，增入時憲。
units.en: After pacifying Xinjiang and the two Jinchuan campaigns, he ordered li-cha remeasured and entered into the Shixian calendar.
units.literal: When the Muslim borderlands and the Two Jinchuan were pacified, he again ordered remeasurement of li-cha and added the results to the Time Constitution calendar.

units.zh: 於是偕伊犁將軍玉麟合疏陳善後事，略曰：「此次入寇，與張格爾不同，不過烏合夷眾，挾驅逐鈔沒之憾，虜掠取償，無志於土地人民。
units.en: He then joined Ili General Yulin in a joint memorial on postwar arrangements, stating in summary: "This invasion differs from Jahangir Khoja's campaign; it is only a mob of tribesmen, nursing grievances over expulsion and confiscation, raiding for compensation, with no ambition to hold territory or people.
units.literal: Thereupon he joined Ili General Yulin in a joint memorial on postwar arrangements, stating in summary: "This invasion differs from Zhangge'er's; it is only a mob of barbarians, bearing the grievance of expulsion and confiscation, raiding for compensation, with no ambition for territory or population.

units.zh: 各白回畏賊騷掠，助順守禦，亦非上年甘心從逆之比。
units.en: White Muslims fear rebel raids and help loyal forces defend the cities—not comparable to last year when many willingly followed the rebels.
units.literal: The various White Muslims fear the rebels' harassment and help the loyal side in defense—not comparable to last year when they willingly followed the rebels.

units.zh: 此時戰緩而守急。
units.en: At this moment offense can wait but defense cannot.
units.literal: At this time offense may be slow but defense is urgent.

units.zh: 惟兵未至而賊已先逃，兵久駐而賊無一獲，戰守俱無長策。
units.en: Yet when troops arrive the rebels have already fled; when troops linger in the field not one rebel is captured—neither offense nor defense offers a sound strategy.
units.literal: Yet when troops have not arrived the rebels have already fled; when troops stay long in the field not one rebel is taken—neither offense nor defense has a good plan.

units.zh: 諸臣條奏增兵廣屯，以省徵調，言之似易，行之實難，即收效亦在數十年之後。
units.en: Officials have proposed increasing troops and expanding frontier colonies to reduce levies; this sounds easy but is hard to implement, and even if it worked, results would come only decades later.
units.literal: Various officials have memorialized in detail to increase troops and expand colonies to save on levies; it sounds easy but is hard in practice, and even if effective the results would come only decades later.

units.zh: 若仿土司以西四城付阿奇木伯克，回性懦弱，非浩罕敵；
units.en: If the four western cities were entrusted to aqim begs on the native-chieftain model, Muslims are by nature weak and no match for Kokand;
units.literal: If on the native-chieftain model the four western cities were entrusted to the aqim begs, Muslims are by nature weak and no match for Kokand;

units.zh: 苟無官兵守禦，賊至必如入無人之境。
units.en: without government troops to defend them, rebels would march in as if through empty land.
units.literal: if there were no government troops to defend them, when rebels came it would be like entering unoccupied territory.

units.zh: 臣等再四籌商，統兵之人宜立不敗之地，斯能製人而不為人制，惟有移參贊大臣於葉爾羌，其地本回疆都會，距喀什噶爾六站，在不遠不近之間。
units.en: We have deliberated repeatedly: the commander must establish an impregnable base so he can control others rather than be controlled—only by moving the assistant military governor to Yarkand, the Muslim frontier capital, six relay stations from Kashgar, at a manageable distance.
units.literal: We have deliberated again and again: the commander should establish himself in an invincible position so he can control others and not be controlled—only by moving the assistant military governor to Yarkand, which is the Muslim frontier metropolis, six relay stations from Kashgar, neither too far nor too near.

units.zh: 再移和闐領隊大臣備調遣。
units.en: Move the Khotan expeditionary commissioner as well to stand ready for deployment.
units.literal: Move the Khotan expeditionary commissioner as well to stand ready for deployment.

units.zh: 喀什噶爾留換防總兵一，與英吉沙爾領隊為犄角。
units.en: Leave one rotating garrison commander at Kashgar to form a pincer with the Yengisar expeditionary force.
units.literal: Leave one rotating garrison commander at Kashgar to form a pincer with the Yengisar expeditionary force.

units.zh: 巴爾楚克駐守總兵一，為樹窩子咽喉鎖鑰。
units.en: Station one commander at Balchuan as the strategic choke point at Shuwazi.
units.literal: Station one commander at Balchuan as the throat-and-lock of Shuwazi.

units.zh: 六城相距均不過數百里。
units.en: The six cities lie within several hundred li of one another.
units.literal: The six cities are all within several hundred li of one another.

units.zh: 於西四城額兵六千之外，留伊犁騎兵三千，陝甘綠營兵四千，量分駐守，而以重兵隨參贊居中調度。
units.en: Beyond the six thousand allotted troops for the four western cities, retain three thousand Ili cavalry and four thousand Shaanxi-Gansu Green Standard troops in distributed garrisons, with a strong central force under the assistant military governor for coordination.
units.literal: Beyond the six thousand allotted troops for the four western cities, retain three thousand Ili cavalry and four thousand Shaanxi-Gansu Green Standard troops, apportioned as garrisons, with heavy forces following the assistant military governor at the center for coordination.

units.zh: 新兵糧餉，請於各省綠營兵額內裁百分之二，歲省三十餘萬，以為回疆兵餉。
units.en: For the new troops' pay and provisions, we request cutting two percent from each province's Green Standard quotas, saving more than three hundred thousand taels annually for Muslim frontier military expenses.
units.literal: For the new troops' pay and provisions, we request cutting two percent from each province's Green Standard quotas, saving more than three hundred thousand taels per year for Muslim frontier military expenses.

units.zh: 俟屯田有效，即以回疆兵食守回疆，仍撤回內地餉額。」
units.en: Once frontier colonies become productive, Muslim frontier grain should support Muslim frontier troops and interior pay quotas can be restored."
units.literal: When frontier colonies become effective, use Muslim frontier grain to support Muslim frontier troops and restore the interior pay quotas."

units.zh: 至十八年林清逆黨之變，上思其言，特賜祭焉。
units.en: By 1813, when Lin Qing's rebels struck, the emperor recalled his words and specially granted sacrificial rites in his honor.
units.literal: By the eighteenth year, when Lin Qing's rebel faction rose, the emperor recalled his words and specially granted sacrificial rites.

units.zh: 林清既誅，滑縣逆匪尋平，論功，迭被優敘，賜子淳為郎中。
units.en: After Lin Qing was executed, the Hua County rebels were soon pacified; in accounting merit Gao received repeated preferential commendation, and his son Chun was given a directorship in a ministry.
units.literal: After Lin Qing was executed, the rebels of Hua County were soon pacified; in accounting merit Gao received repeated preferential commendation, and his son Chun was given the post of director in a ministry.

units.zh: 林清逆黨突入禁城，時回鑾，中途聞變，有議俟調大兵成列而後進者，誥曰：「是滋亂也，獻俘者行至矣！」
units.en: Lin Qing's rebels suddenly entered the Forbidden City; the court was returning from Rehe and heard of the disturbance en route; some proposed waiting until large forces were assembled before advancing—Gao said, "That would only encourage disorder; the captors are already on their way!"
units.literal: Lin Qing's rebel faction suddenly entered the Forbidden City; at that time the court was returning from Rehe; midway they heard of the disturbance; some proposed waiting until large forces were assembled in formation before advancing—Gao said, "That would only encourage disorder; those who present captives are already on the road!"

units.en: In the spring of the sixteenth year the Shunzhi Emperor went to the Southern Park, and Yongjian submitted a memorial: 'Recently, because Your Majesty was unwell, the court announced that the spring sacrifice at the Grand Temple would be performed by dispatched officials.
units.literal: In the spring of the sixteenth year the Shizu Emperor visited the Southern Park; Yongjian memorialized, saying: 'Yesterday, because the Sacred Person was unwell, an edict was issued that at the first month of spring the Grand Temple would be feasted and officials dispatched to perform the sacrifice.
